Goal: q_max #1011 (integration PR int-batch-qmax-r5, head b602fd459, CI green) lands, then the q_max batch (#1020, #1019, #1014-#1018).
Problem (rule): the merge tool refuses a merge onto a main whose state is unknown unless a reason is given, and q_max's browser tests run on CI only when you start them, so either way the merge waits on you.
Based on (measured): #1011 is green on all 19 checks and includes today's main.
Based on (read): main's last two browser runs never finished: one hit the 3-hour limit, the other was stopped at 23:01 CST.
Departs from: main merges only after a proven browser run on main — B merges #1011 with main's browser state unproven.

options.gain: main's browser state is known before #1011 lands.
options.how: Press: https://github.com/shivinate7/q_max/actions/workflows/browser.yml → Run workflow → branch main. Then #1011 merges the normal way if it is green.
options.label: Run main's browser tests once
options.lose: One full browser run of GitHub minutes, and #1011 waits for it; the last two such runs never finished, so this one may hang too.

options.how: Type to runner 9: merge q_max #1011 with --base-red-ok "browser run cancelled, no red job".
options.label: Merge now
